label: spin_pair_full
method: Consecutive raw scans converted with fixed approved extrinsics, voxelised with per-voxel mean point time. Multiscale ICP from identity (point/plane per registration_method), equal independent reverse procedure, geometric Schur rotation/translation conditioning. No IMU, body attitude, vendor odometry or map used to initialize registration.
limits: Full scans can be motion-distorted; scan-average effective time is uncertain.
Good overlap/conditioning/cycle consistency do not prove correct correspondences or true registration.
Quality thresholds are diagnostic choices, not a calibration accuracy specification.
